title: Repeated preview READY messages amplified parent initialization
scope: Local ChatGPT Sites Worker browser runtime; no untrusted source code was executed

attack.sender: The route's opaque sandboxed preview iframe (window.origin is null)

before.command: pnpm exec playwright test --config tests/e2e/sites-preview.playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/sites-preview-csp.spec.ts -g "a preview can trigger only one parent initialization response" --project=sites-chromium
before.result: failed as expected before the fix
before.cause: The host replied to every READY message from the iframe, without checking that its resource ID matched or limiting initialization to once per iframe load.

checks: A mismatched resource ID receives no initialization reply.
Eight replayed READY messages receive only one initialization reply.
Selecting the Quiet variant reloads the preview and establishes one new handshake.

deploymentVerification: pending release-candidate deployment; this local fix is not claimed as verified on the public Site
